cover.title: 5 Apps for a GLP-1 Cut
cover.subtitle: The scale can't tell fat from muscle. These can.

caption: 5 apps for losing weight on a GLP-1 without losing muscle 💉 The scale can't tell fat from muscle — but #3 can.
